Standard: The air vehicle design includes loads derived from events not captured in normal ground and flight operations, including: a. Crash. b. Bird strike and foreign object debris. c. Hail and lightning. d. Transport of air vehicle by ground, water or air. e. Maintenance and abuse loads. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Verify the ASIP Master Plan or RSIP Master Plan, as specified in MIL-STD-1530 or MIL- STD-3063 respectively, documents the analysis and test verification methods required to certify the miscellaneous design loads; structural certification tasks are updated for modifications or changes to the air vehicle following initial AW certification basis; and all artifacts are developed IAW applicable sections of MIL-STD-1530 or MIL-STD-3063.
(2) Verify detailed structural design criteria for miscellaneous loads, as specified in MIL-STD- 1530 or MIL-STD-3063, documents the requirements to achieve structural integrity.
(3) Verify test plans are scoped to measure all miscellaneous flight loads to allow for tracking margins to achieve envelope expansion. Analysis.
  (1) Verify loads analysis models are updated with developmental tests, and predictions demonstrate the miscellaneous loads are compliant with structural design criteria. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Verify bird strike, hail strike, and lightning tests demonstrate integrity for flight-critical structure or structure protecting flight-critical systems, and the results are used to update analyses and validate structural capabilities. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(4) Verify strength summary and operating restrictions define the operational envelope and necessary restrictions; reflect all analyses and tests; and satisfy the structural design criteria.
(5) Verify the flight manual is consistent with the envelope and limitations defined in the strength summary and operating restrictions for all air vehicle configurations.
